standard-dialogue.player: Good day. What are you doing?

standard-dialogue.npc: I'm tending to these farming patches. They need a little more work before I can plant anything.

steps.npc: The centre patch is full of weeds, and as soon as I clear them they grow back. The south patch is always far too dry. And the soil in the north patch is terrible; it needs a good dose of compost.

right-click-check-approval.player: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?

right-click-check-approval-before-comple.player: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?

right-click-check-approval-before-comple.npc: Kingdom? Etceteria is ruled by a Queen and we don't approve of you.

attempting-to-rake-the-weeds-watering-th.npc: Don't trouble yourself further, Your Highness, you've already done so much!
Hey! This is the Queen's farm. You'll need her approval to make use of it.

if-the-storerooms-are-full.npc: The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
